THESIS STATUS: WEAKENED
ADJUSTED CONFIDENCE: 45%

OVERNIGHT SUMMARY: Futures have deteriorated significantly from overnight highs, with ES down -0.34% and NQ down -0.46%. VIX spiked +3.43% to 25.0, indicating rising fear and negating the previous bullish setup.

KEY DEVELOPMENTS:
• ES futures fell 25 points from overnight levels (~6653 to 6628), breaking below key support
• VIX surge to 25.0 suggests institutional hedging/risk-off positioning
• Negative GEX regime (-291M) with Call Wall at 658 creating resistance near our short strike
• Polymarket macro composite turned bearish (-0.18) with recession odds at 32.5%
• European strength (+0.76% DAX) not translating to US futures

TRADE RECOMMENDATION STATUS: ADJUST
TRADE NOTES: Current setup is compromised. Call Wall at 658 is problematic as our short strike is 660. Consider closing position if ES breaks 6620 or VIX sustains above 25.5. Alternative: roll down to 655/656 spread if opportunity presents.

DAY AHEAD RISKS:
• VIX above 25 suggests continuation selling pressure
• Negative GEX could accelerate downside moves
• ES approaching 6620 support level - break could trigger algorithmic selling
• Time decay accelerating with 7 DTE and reduced implied vol expansion potential

DAY AHEAD OPPORTUNITIES:
• Oversold bounce potential if ES holds 6620
• VIX mean reversion trade if fear spike proves overdone
• Intraday short squeeze possible given negative GEX environment
